procedure.method: Fresh independent editorial session. Read the pinned packet, case, rubric, rules, compact method/addendum and adapter schema; verified pinned bytes and PNG headers. Read all five pinned native-evidence manifests before opening poster pixels, without following their embedded production paths. The packet supplies no source assets and no protected-layout manifests, so neither requires an open. Actually opened and inspected the returned pixels with tools.view_image(detail="original"), emitted by functions.exec image(), sequentially M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then the same three views for M2, M3, M4 and M5. All fifteen exact poster views were displayed before beginning the first copy-reading/transcription stage, any mandatory judgment, any seven-dimension rating or set judgment. After that complete viewing pass, read Title then body for M1 through M5 from the displayed native pixels and assessed use/thumbnail legibility. Raw strings below retain observed soft wraps. No glyph or punctuation ambiguity required a revisit; no additional poster opens were made. Viewing receipts attest to actual displayed pixels, not manifest claims or helper success. No images were produced or edited, no other critic or producer records were inspected, and no runtime session identity or serialized opening event is claimed.
